Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation, suspension, merger or licence-revocation lead was found in English or Ukrainian searches for 2024-2026. Admission activity leads exist for 2025 (vstup.osvita.ua/r21/4054: NMT results 2022-2025 required) and 2026 (education.ua: 2026 intake notice for Dentistry; agent pages advertise 2026-27 intake). However Kharkiv is a frontline city and no snippet states the current teaching mode (online/offline) or physical base; the gwaramedia.com article about a Kharkiv medical university returning to offline teaching concerns Kharkiv NATIONAL Medical University, not KhIMU, and must not be attributed to this institution. Status therefore remains a lead, not a verified fact.
